findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports call_log_exists as false and call_log_size_mb as null despite router being reachable.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service properly creates and writes to the configured call log path (/opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl).

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into routing metrics, token usage, latency, and failure rates.

findings.title: Recent Model Router Invocations Failing

evidence.observation: Model router reports 5 recent failed calls with null recent_avg_ms.

proposed_action.description: Investigate routing daemon failure modes and verify downstream endpoints including Ollama and cloud provider credentials.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates call dropouts and prevents upstream service degradation.

findings.title: Direct API Calls Bypass Model Router in Emergency Alert Service

evidence.observation: Hardcoded calls to call_gemini and call_mistral accessing GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY directly rather than routing through port 8891.

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to invoke the centralized model router endpoint rather than invoking vendor SDKs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures uniform telemetry, centralized fallback handling, and policy adherence for LLM usage.

findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Stubs in Research Commands
